purpose: Original exterior models for the owner-requested Mycity import. Game code and Project 0 platform services are not included in this asset package.
loadingNotes: Configure GLTFLoader with MeshoptDecoder for EXT_meshopt_compression and KHR_mesh_quantization.
LOD1 is the lighter city representation; LOD0 retains original animation clips where available.
All imported GLBs are self-contained: no external buffer or image URI references.

lots.title: Meridian Ironwatch
lots.description: A neon fortress tower guarding the Meridian reactor. Hover tanks patrol the base while raider saucers circle; the crown core flares when you tap it. Enter to play: a twin-stick tank defence across three sectors, three bosses and endless Overtime.

lots.title: Convoy Chaos — Golden Routes v0.8
lots.description: Your blue semi carries rotating photographs of thirteen other Nothatcher lots. Overhead signs cycle through their lot numbers as the rooftop runner jumps. Utility posts, wire, trees and road markings rush past, fade away and reappear ahead. Enter to play six rooftop-running routes.

lots.title: BLACKBOX: Recovery Protocol
lots.description: A downloaded Kenney orbital hangar, cargo courier, rover and rotating satellite dish. Animated recovery beacons and amber warning bands mark a disabled station. Enter BLACKBOX: restore power, recover its flight recorder and escape the security drones.

lots.title: Crownfall: The Ashen March
lots.description: A weathered frontier fortress: vaulted gatehouse, iron portcullis, crenellated towers, timber hoardings, slate keep, reflective moat and wind-tossed banners. Enter Crownfall for mounted combat, a recruitable warband and a four-contract medieval campaign.

lots.title: Crownstone Keep: Castle Games
lots.description: A monumental castle gatehouse with a deep arched entrance, raised red gable, sunburst crest, paired stone guardians, buttresses and tall matching spires.

lots.title: Orbital Shipyard: City Flight
lots.description: A rebuilt orbital drydock with broad curved structural ribs, thick docking collar, jointed service arms and mechanical latches around the spacecraft.

lots.title: Ashen Owl: Cinders & Cards
lots.description: Enter the Living Library: a feathered owl watches over a curled grimoire, a card table and eight glowing ante lanterns. Learn at a guided practice table, then face progressively tougher blinds.

lots.title: The Sevenfold Archive
lots.description: A black-stone and neon-celestial archive of Project 0's seven-key hunt: confirmed clues, lost commands, the inverted city, Lot Zero, two-part key, theories and an interactive guestbook inside. Enter to explore.

lots.title: The Last Beacon: Do Not Answer
lots.description: A weathered lighthouse with tall wind-swaying Poly Haven coastal grass, a gravel path and a hooded groundskeeper walking his endless rounds. Enter to investigate a point-and-click lighthouse horror mystery: Do Not Answer.

experience.title: The Last Beacon: Do Not Answer

lots.title: Abyssal Relic — Full Resolution
lots.description: The ancient bronze candle relic gains broken temple arches, guardian pylons, ritual buttresses and a sculpted basalt-and-bronze foundation.

lots.title: Stormglass: Keeper's Watch
lots.description: A red-and-white lighthouse above a deep sea cave, with a physical stone bridge, cliff platform, exterior spiral stair and sculpted bronze lantern cage. Now with animated beacon light, sea spray and tidal glints and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

lots.title: Tideborn — Your Creature, Your Beginning
lots.description: A tentacle-wrapped lighthouse framed by broken bronze armillary arches, suspended rune stones and four floating coral-and-crystal altar groups. Now with animated beacon light, floating keeper lights and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

lots.title: Relicfall: Beneath the Beacon
lots.description: A weathered, colourful lighthouse on a rocky outcrop, rising over the city. Now with animated beacon light, sea spray and tidal glints and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

lots.title: Skybound: Beaconfall
lots.description: A hovering tropical island with cliffs, palms, turquoise water and a lighthouse. The island rises and falls on a slow magical current while three clouds drift independently overhead. Now with animated beacon light, drifting aether wisps and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

lots.title: Beaconfall — The Lantern Frontier v0.9
lots.description: A towering wooden lookout with a snowy peaked roof and warmly lit windows. A rustic winter landmark above the city. Now with animated beacon light, falling snow and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

lots.title: RELICFALL: Beneath the Beacon v0.8
lots.description: The lighthouse didn't sink—it grew claws. Now its unlikely keeper prowls the drowned coast, guiding lost souls through the fog and snapping at whatever follows. Now with animated beacon light, floating keeper lights and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking navy-cloaked coastal keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.
